name: 20782 · Hyattsville, MD
findings: ZIP 20782 (Hyattsville) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20782 (Hyattsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
